answer: A maturation vault gates each new identity: its earnings accrue into a locked garden plot that unlocks only after thirty consecutive honest epochs. When the registry detects a duplicate, the operator's entire unvested plot is burned into the common forge fund, and every further duplicate extends the maturation window. An attacker therefore forfeits the full pending reward stream plus thirty epochs of locked capital per fake identity, a relic debt that scales linearly, while honest operators never lose a coin.
